prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Marta, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Marta thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The neighborhood council is officially starting a ruthless crackdown next month, and they will be handing out massive fines to anyone who leaves their bins out for even a second past 8am! You better be careful because they’re planning to monitor every single house constantly."
text: The council is launching an aggressive surveillance state next month to hunt down anyone with a bin out, and they’re ready to bankrupt us with massive fines. It’s clear they’re finally coming for all of us, so expect them to be watching your property 24/7.
